channel.title: Engineered Systems Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Engineered Systems Magazine (esmagazine.com)

item.title: Are You Actually Ready for an EPA Audit?
item.description: Many contractors overlook EPA 608 compliance, but expanded AIM Act rules and rising enforcement mean even good contractors face steep penalties if they can’t document proper refrigerant handling.

item.title: How Atticman Raised the Bar, Not Their Headcount, to Build an Elite HVAC Team
item.description: Atticman shows how a focus on people, processes, and financial clarity transforms an HVAC company into a standard-bearer.

item.title: LG Expands Heat Pump Training Facility in Derby
item.description: The UK expansion builds on LG’s wider global investment in heat pump technologies, including consortium-based research programmes across Europe, North America and Asia, focused on improving heat pump efficiency, dependability and performance across diverse climates.

item.title: HVAC Price Increase List: February 2026
item.description: The groundhog saw his shadow, and that means at least six more weeks of increasing prices on HVAC equipment.

item.title: HVAC Q&A Episode 19: Getting On Board the Heat Pump Train
item.description: How do you get ‘old-school guys’ excited about heat pumps? Jim Bergmann, president of MeasureQuick, used to be one of those guys. Then he installed a heat pump in his basement — and everything changed. In this video, Bergmann explains the BTUs that made him a believer — and why the old saying “don’t knock it ‘till you try it” holds true with heat pumps.

item.title: Copeland Acquires Bueno Analytics
item.description: The integration of Bueno’s platform and Copeland will deliver capabilities including predictive maintenance, energy management, leak detection, workforce efficiency tools, and advanced analytics.

item.title: Survey Reveals Strategies to Boost HVAC Close Rates by Double Digits
item.description: New survey data shows that something as simple as always offering financing to customers can improve close rates on installs by 11%.

item.title: Carrier’s Residential Sales Plunge Nearly 40% in Q4
item.description: Carrier’s residential sales dropped nearly 40% in Q4 as the channel destocked and homeowners delayed replacements. The company expects replacement demand to rebound later this year.

item.title: AHR Expo Brings 53,315 HVACR Professionals to Las Vegas
item.description: AHR Expo is honored to provide the once-a-year opportunity for the full community to come together for a few days.

item.title: Dual Fuel Solutions Offer Peace of Mind
item.description: Contractors are leaning into dual fuel solutions as a way to give homeowners more efficient comfort, and better peace of mind.
